Description:
Creates port forwarding:
This template creates port forwarding and then maps port 100 from the public network IP to port 22 of the VM. Prerequisites:
The instance offering, image, private network, and public network are created. Make sure that the networks are working as expected. Otherwise, the port forwarding may fail to be created or fail to work properly after creation
